Although she hasn't been seen for a century past, her kin still roam the dark waters.}} == Acquisition == === Contained in === {{contained in}} === Recipe === {{recipe | source = Mystic Forge | quantity = 1 | ingredient1 = 1 Carcharias | ingredient2 = 1 Gift of Kamohoali'i Kotaki | ingredient3 = 1 Gift of Fortune | ingredient4 = 1 Gift of Mastery }} == Graphics == [[Kamohoali'i Kotaki]] is a shark spear that has a purple glow on it and leaves a trail of blood in the water as you swim. ; Aura * The user's body is surrounded by bubbles and scales. ;Footfalls * The user leaves behind splashes of water, from which a ghostly shark breaches and chomps. ; Critical hit effects * Critical strikes while wielding Kamohoali'i Kotaki will cause a spirit shark to chomp the enemy. The size of the spirit shark varies depending on the model of the enemy. This animation only appears for the following abilities: ** Aquatic *** {{g}} [[Guardian]]: [[Zealot's Flurry]] and [[Wrathful Grasp]] *** {{w}} [[Warrior]]: [[Whirling Strike]], [[Stab (warrior Cut]], and [[Vital Draw]] *** {{re}} [[Revenant]]: [[Abyssal Blot]] ;Draw/Stow effects * When drawn, a burst of bubbles emanates from the user's body and a echo noise is heard. The shark's mouth at the end of the spear also opens and the spearhead comes out. * When stowed, the spearhead retracts and the shark's mouth closes ; Skill effects * Default projectiles are replaced with spirit shark projectiles. === Gallery === File:Kamohoali'i Kotaki concept art.jpg|Concept art by [[Kekai Kotaki]]. Kotaki is the last name of [[Kekai Kotaki]], a former ArenaNet concept artist who conceptualized this weapon. * This item was named ''Maw of the Deep'' during beta testing. == Notes == {{bug| * In October of 2024, the draw and stow animations were fixed after years of being broken. * When equipping Kamohoali'i Kotaki with your weapon unsheathed outside of water, you will show part of the blue water-like aura; this won't fade away until you mount or change areas.}} == See also == * [[Kamohoali'i Kotaki I: The Experimental Spear]] * [[Kamohoali'i Kotaki II: The Perfected Spear]] * [[Kamohoali'i Kotaki III: Carcharias]] {{Legendary weapon nav|1|Kamohoali'i Kotaki}} [[de:Kamohoali'i Kotaki]] [[es:Kamohoali'i Kotaki]] [[fr:Kamohoali'i Kotaki]]
